instructions: WordCraft is a word processor (a Microsoft Word clone). Every action is a command: find ids and parameters with list_commands and run them with execute (or several with batch). Positions are {story:"body", path:[block,(row,cell,block)...], off:byteOffset}. Typical flow: new_document → type_text "Hello" → execute text.newParagraph → execute para.style {style:"Heading 1"} → select_text {text:"Hello"} → execute format.bold → inspect_document to verify → render_page to look at the result → save {path:"out.docx"}. Backend: headless session (no window). Community: https://discord.gg/artcraft · https://getartcraft.com/apps/wordcraft · https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run commands in order; stops at the first error unless keepGoing.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click at window coordinates (desktop app only).

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run one command by id with params, e.g. {command:"format.bold"} or {command:"insert.table", params:{rows:3, cols:4}}.

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Plain text of the document body.

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.description: Structure: blocks with text, styles, formatting runs, lists, tables, sections, parts, selection, pages.

tools.name: key
tools.description: Press a key with modifiers (desktop app only), e.g. {key:"B", cmd:true}.

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: Every WordCraft command: id, label, ribbon location, shortcut and params. Filter with `query`.

tools.name: new_document
tools.description: Start a document: blank, sample, letter, resume or report.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open a .docx, .doc, .odt, .rtf, .md, .tex, .html, .txt or .json file, or any other text file (.m3u, .log, .ini…) as plain text.

tools.name: parity
tools.description: WordCraft's command coverage of the word-processor feature catalog.

tools.name: render_page
tools.description: Render a page to PNG to look at the result.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Save (format from the extension: docx, pdf, odt, rtf, html, md, tex, txt, png).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot of the whole WordCraft window (desktop app only).

tools.name: select_text
tools.description: Select the n-th occurrence of some text.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type at the caret (replacing the selection). Use \n... for line breaks inside text; use execute text.newParagraph for new paragraphs, or `paragraphs: true` to split lines into paragraphs.

tools.name: ui_inspect
tools.description: UI state: tab, panes, dialog, page rectangles on screen, caret (desktop app only).
